# Dhiraj KC

> A portfolio that brings together technical delivery, design execution, research support, and operational leadership in one clear narrative.

My recent work spans web platforms, event production, social media systems, and technical coordination. This site is designed to show how those threads connect rather than present them as isolated roles.

This `llms.txt` file is generated from the portfolio content files during local development and production builds.
Every page also has a Markdown version: append `.md` to the page path (for example `/projects/neptou.md`). The links below point to those Markdown versions.

## Site

- [Home](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/index.md): I build and support digital products, communication systems, and operational structures for organizations and technical communities.
- [Projects](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects.md): Portfolio case studies across engineering, design, research, and leadership work.
- [Experience](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/experience.md): Full role history with dates, summaries, and related projects.
- [Recognition](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/recognition.md): Awards and honors, with sources.
- [Contact](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/contact.md): Contact information and profile links.

## Featured Projects

- [Neptou](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/neptou.md): Built and lead the full technical stack for Neptou, a Nepal travel companion app, across a native SwiftUI iOS app, a FastAPI and Postgres backend with Claude-powered planning, and a Next.js website and admin panel.
- [Youth Activism Nepal (Website)](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/youth-activism-nepal-platform.md): Built and maintain a custom web platform while owning hosting, deployment, and the surrounding operational infrastructure.
- [Agrineer Volume 8 Layout Design](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/agrineer-layout-design.md): Designed the editorial layout for Agrineer Volume 8 with a focus on readability, pacing, and polished print presentation.
- [Digital Nomad Tax Freedom Index 2025](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/digital-nomad-tax-freedom-index-2025.md): Supported comparative research for Liberty International's 2025 digital nomad policy index by compiling tax, visa, and residency indicators across countries.
- [ICRTAI 2025 Conference Visual and AV Production](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/icrtai-2025-conference-visual-av.md): Led visual design and live AV execution for a large hybrid AI conference, supporting stage content, branding materials, and real-time session delivery.
- [Soccer Match Highlights Event Extraction](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/soccer-match-highlights-event-extraction.md): Built a multimodal AI pipeline that detects key match events and generates structured highlight outputs from full-length football videos.
- [X-Hack 3.0 AI Hackathon](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/x-hack-3-ai-hackathon.md): Helped coordinate CS50 AI Inspired X-Hack 3.0, a national hackathon focused on AI-driven business and social innovation.
- [CS50 AI Nepal Classes and Program](https://dhirajkc195.com.np/projects/cs50x-nepal-program-delivery.md): Helped plan and deliver Nepal's first large-scale CS50 AI program, combining technical instruction, curriculum execution, and a structured public-facing learning journey.
